description: This file defines classes and enums related to Bluetooth AVDTP (Audio/Video Distribution Transport Protocol) socket communication, including Payload, Signal, and Socket classes, with methods for handling signals, packets, and socket states.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Represents the AVDTP payload data, derived from DataRecordBE, with builder and inspector function types.

classes.name: Signal
classes.description: Represents an AVDTP signal message, including enums for signal identifiers, error codes, message types, and packet types, with methods for serialization, deserialization, and inspection.

classes.name: Socket
classes.description: Represents an AVDTP socket for Bluetooth communication, supporting signal handling, packet processing, and socket state management, with nested classes for request and response signals, and command handling.

classes.name: ResponseHandler
classes.description: Handles responses for signals, encapsulating acceptor and rejector callbacks.

classes.name: CommandType<ADMIN>
classes.description: Template class for managing command signals over the socket, with nested Request and Response classes for request/response handling.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the signal or socket data into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into a signal or socket message.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets up a signal with specific parameters.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming signal with optional payload.

methods.name: Reject
methods.description: Rejects an incoming signal with error code and optional data.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Abstract method to handle socket operational state changes.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles changes in socket state, updating MTU and operational status.
